name: LibreWolf Desktop & ESP32 Base Environment
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pcmanfm && mkdir -p /config/Downloads ~/.librewolf-data && sudo find /config -xdev -exec chown -h $(whoami):$(whoami) {} +
postStartCommand: docker start librewolf-vnc 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --restart always --name librewolf-vnc -p 6080:3000 -e CUSTOM_PORT=3000 -v /home/vscode/.librewolf-data:/config -v /home/vscode:/config/Desktop/workspace lscr.io/linuxserver/librewolf:latest
